metadata.name: e21-device-removal-review-readback
metadata.description: Review removal of the leased disposable owner device, confirm the warning, and verify owner-scoped list readback.
Owner-routed removal of only the disposable fixture device, including explicit review and latest list readback.

metadata.label: Open Settings in the same disposable owner fixture
Wait for Settings before setting selected appearance
Set the exact selected light appearance
Open the leased disposable owner device fixture
Wait for the exact selected removal target in the owner list
Open the disposable Travel phone readiness detail without changing device state
Wait for the selected Travel phone detail

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-demo-phone]');const text=root?.innerText||'';const body=document.body.innerText||'';const readiness=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-readiness-unknown]');if(!readiness||!readiness.classList.contains('border-s-4')||!readiness.classList.contains('border-app-warning'))throw new Error('unknown readiness must retain its warning treatment');if(!root||!text.includes('Travel phone')||!text.includes('demo-phone')||!text.includes('demo-mobile')||!text.includes('Unknown — no exact channel and machine readiness record is available for this device.')||body.includes('fixture://'))throw new Error('readiness detail missing exact identity or current unknown disclosure: '+text);const overflow=document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth+1;const buttons=[...(root.querySelectorAll('button')||[])].map(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return {id:b.id,label:b.innerText,width:Math.round(r.width),height:Math.round(r.height)}});const below44=buttons.filter(b=>b.width<44||b.height<44);if(overflow||below44.length)throw new Error('readiness detail has a target below 44 CSS px or horizontal overflow: '+JSON.stringify({overflow,below44}));return {device:'demo-phone',machine:'demo-mobile',readiness:'unknown',targets:buttons,below44,overflow}})()

metadata.label: Assert unknown readiness stays unassigned and private endpoint data stays hidden

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-demo-phone]');const target=[...(root?.querySelectorAll('p')||[])].find(e=>e.textContent?.includes('Unknown — no exact channel and machine readiness record is available for this device.'));if(!root||!target)throw new Error('Readiness unknown detail is absent');target.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return {scrolledToReadiness:true,viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight}}})()

metadata.label: Position the selected readiness detail in the phone viewport before capture

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.documentElement;r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top','0px');r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom','0px');for(const key of ['left','right'])r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||r.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='light')throw new Error('selected light readiness viewport/theme mismatch');return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme:'light',insets:{top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0}}})()

metadata.label: Normalize selected light 390 by 844 CSS viewport with zero safe-area insets
Capture selected light NH16-SET-03 Readiness unknown phone state

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.documentElement;r.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');r.setAttribute('data-resolved-theme','dark');for(const key of ['top','right','bottom','left'])r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||r.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='dark')throw new Error('selected dark readiness viewport/theme mismatch');return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme:'dark',insets:{top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0}}})()

metadata.label: Normalize selected dark 390 by 844 CSS viewport with zero safe-area insets
Capture selected dark NH16-SET-03 Readiness unknown phone state
Restore light appearance before the existing disposable removal review
Select Work browser by its exact disposable owner row before removal
Confirm the exact Work browser device is selected
Open the device removal review

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const review=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-remove-review]');const text=review?.textContent||'';const heading=review?.querySelector('h1');const buttons=[...(review?.querySelectorAll('button')||[])];const heights=buttons.map(b=>b.getBoundingClientRect().height);for(const expected of ['does not revoke browser permission','Work browser','Device ID','Machine','Channel'])if(!text.includes(expected))throw new Error('removal review missing '+expected);if(document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-device-demo-work]'))throw new Error('device list remains behind focused removal review');if(document.activeElement!==heading)throw new Error('removal review heading did not receive focus');if(heights.length!==2||heights.some(h=>h<44))throw new Error('removal actions below 44 CSS px: '+heights.join(','));return {fixtureDevice:'device-demo-work',reviewed:true,browserPermissionUnchanged:true,headingFocused:true,actionHeights:heights}})()

metadata.label: Verify the exact owner device and bounded removal consequence
Verify selected phone state and zero safe-area insets

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.documentElement;r.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');r.setAttribute('data-resolved-theme','dark');for(const key of ['top','right','bottom','left'])r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||r.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='dark')throw new Error('selected dark viewport/theme mismatch');return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme:'dark',insets:{top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0}}})()

metadata.label: Set exact selected dark phone theme and zero safe-area insets without changing owner data
Capture dark selected device-removal review before confirming the disposable fixture

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.documentElement;r.setAttribute('data-theme','light');r.setAttribute('data-resolved-theme','light');if(r.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='light')throw new Error('light review capture restoration failed');return {theme:'light',sameReviewState:Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-remove-review]'))}})()

metadata.label: Restore the existing light capture state before the original capture and confirmation
Capture the light phone removal review before confirmation

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const review=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-remove-review]');const confirm=review?.querySelector('button[data-rcl-button]');if(!confirm)throw new Error('fixture removal confirmation button missing');confirm.click();return {confirmedDisposableFixture:true}})()

metadata.label: Confirm removal using the explicit review action for only the leased fixture ID
Wait until the latest owner-scoped device list no longer contains the fixture ID

evaluate.expression: (()=>{if(document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-device-demo-work]'))throw new Error('removed fixture still appears in owner list');const result=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-removed]');const text=result?.textContent||'';if(!result||!text.includes('Removal confirmed by the latest list')||!text.includes('Travel phone')||!text.includes('demo-phone'))throw new Error(`removal result is incomplete: ${text}`);return {fixtureDevice:'device-demo-work',absentFromLatestOwnerList:true,remainingFixture:'demo-phone',dedicatedResultVisible:true}})()

metadata.label: Confirm the removed fixture ID is absent after authoritative refresh
Capture the owner list after disposable device removal readback

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.documentElement;r.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');r.setAttribute('data-resolved-theme','dark');for(const key of ['top','right','bottom','left'])r.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||r.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='dark')throw new Error('dark removal readback viewport/theme mismatch');return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme:'dark',insets:{top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0},resultStillVisible:Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-device-removed]'))}})()
